name: kicad-eda
description: Concept-to-Gerbers PCB design for KiCad 9/10. Two workflows: a fully HEADLESS gated pipeline (netlist.json -> schematic+ERC -> SWIG board build -> Freerouting -> DRC -> fab zip, with IEEE 15288.2-style self-remediating gates), and a GUI-assisted 10-stage flow. Bundles the kicad-generator MCP server, gate-reviewer subagents, IPC-2221/2141A rules math, the Freerouting 1.9 autorouter jar, and cross-platform guardrail hooks.
